title: sisymbrium austriacum var. tillieri
intro: Sisymbrium austriacum var. tillieri, commonly known as Austrian mustard or wild mustard, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sisymbrium austriacum var. tillieri include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms associated with colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
